paragraphs.text: Kamachal , the Ship's Mascot is a dinosaur pirate from Ixalan .

Kamachal is a small, feathered dinosaur who has been taken as a mascot on one of the Brazen Coalition 's ships. Kamachal's feathers are blue, green, and yellow, and one of its claws has been replaced with a hook. It's also been dressed up in some additional pirate gear, including a leather cape with a large buckle, a red kerchief with several adornments, and a pierced jaw. It sits on the shoulder of an orcish pirate captain.
